body.content: What if the 'single evaluation' evidence is found in the 'time-to-judgment' metric? Mere compliance with a checklist usually follows a linear time-progression (Item 1 -> Item 2 -> Item 3). Genuine reliability involving critical judgment would show 'non-linear' time spikes—long pauses at specific items where the panel is actually debating the application of the rule. This turns the temporal trace of the evaluation into a proxy for the cognitive mechanism used.
body.why_keep_this: Proposes a quantitative, behavioral metric for the 'genuine vs compliance' distinction.
